The '''Shipyard Depot''' was a vast [[salvage yard]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. It was utilized by the [[New Republic]] [[New Republic Defense Force|Defense Force]] to decommissioned [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyers]] from the former [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy|Navy]] and were also simultaneously dismantling the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]], and as such was guarded by [[New Republic soldier]]s. The shipyard shared its name with the [[hovertrain]] station of the Coruscant transit network servicing the area.

==History==
In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Penn Pershing]] and another member of [[Moff]] [[Gideon]] [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|Imperial remnant]], [[Elia Kane]], at the time part of the [[New Republic Amnesty Program]], infiltrated the shipyard to [[Mission to retrieve the mobile lab station|steal a mobile lab]] to facilitate the former's [[cloning]] [[Imperial cloning program|research]]. However, Kane exposed the conspiracy to the New Republic and Pershing was arrested and sent to the [[Re-Integration Institute]].<ref name="Chapter 19" />
